rule.name: own_brand_leading_token
rule.description: Casefold and collapse whitespace; strip ONE leading token equal to the member's own brand (the whole brand string or the first word of a multi-word brand) followed by whitespace; the remainder must be non-empty. Suffixes, hyphens, punctuation and revisions are never touched.
rule.scope: same normalised brand only (catalog.normalize); never across brands
rule.audit_note: The generated list is a same-brand audit list only. It includes pairs for brand strings the family table deliberately does not map (Inspur Corporation, Inspur ... (IEI)); those imply no IEIT/Inspur relation. No output consumes the aliases: there is no "also known as" display or alias lookup.
